item.title: Arknights: Endfield makes $46m in first month on mobile
item.description: Gryphline’s gacha RPG Arknights: Endfield has generated $46 million in its first month on mobile. According to AppMagic estimates, iOS players have accounted for the bulk of that spending at $28.3m, or 61%. Google Play gamers have spent the remaining $17.7m. ... [MORE]

item.title: "Bad news for Xbox": Analysts react to the leadership shakeup at Microsoft's games division
item.description: Microsoft’s games division has gone through its biggest shakeup in leadership since the departure of former Xbox boss Don Mattrick following the infamous Xbox One reveal during E3 2013. Executive VP of gaming Phil Spencer has retired after 12 years in charge and 38 years with the company. Xbox president Sarah Bond has also departed. ... [MORE]

item.title: Krafton appoints Kangwook Lee as chief AI officer
item.description: Korean publisher Krafton has appointed head of Krafton AI Kangwook Lee as its new chief AI officer. In his new role, Lee will lead the company's AI research and long-term innovation strategy. The appointment recognises his AI expertise, leadership, and years of research and project experience in AI technology development. He has been leading Krafton AI since 2022. ... [MORE]

item.title: Giant secures $8m to expand AI-powered storytelling for children
item.description: AI-powered storytelling platform Giant has raised $8 million to scale and expand its interactive offerings for children. The funding will help Giant build worlds where children star in personalised stories, interacting with memory-driven characters that evolve alongside them. ... [MORE]

item.title: BidOn expands leadership and establishes board to advance open source ad tech
item.description: Non-profit ad infrastructure BidOn has expanded its leadership and engineering team to advance its open source and ad tech offerings. The company has established a board comprising senior figures from across mobile gaming and ad monetisation, including executives from Scopely, Zynga, TapNation, 52 Entertainment, ParshipMeet Group and PubRev+. ... [MORE]

item.title: LA County sues Roblox over alleged child safety failures
item.description: Los Angeles County has filed a lawsuit against Roblox, alleging the platform has “failed to protect children from predatory behaviour” despite marketing itself as a safe digital space. The complaint claims children have been repeatedly exposed to sexually explicit content, exploitation and grooming, arguing that Roblox’s design and moderation systems allow adults to target minors, impersonate children and build influence through repeated interactions. ... [MORE]

item.title: Nexon appoints Patrick Söderlund as executive chairman effective immediately
item.description: Japanese publisher Nexon has appointed Patrick Söderlund as its new executive chairman effective immediately. In the newly created role, Söderlund will take broad authority over Nexon’s long-term strategy, creative direction and global game development framework. ... [MORE]

item.title: Blizzard unveils Overwatch Rush "specifically for mobile players"
item.description: The Overwatch series is getting a brand-new mobile spinoff in Overwatch Rush. Announced today, Blizzard’s new top-down hero shooter is being developed specifically with mobile in mind. It’s set in the Overwatch universe and is being created by a dedicated Blizzard team - separate from Team 4. ... [MORE]
